research.title: Image Classification Robustness Under Acquisition Shifts
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare image classifiers under blur, compression, and illumination shifts using consistent training splits and preprocessing.
Evaluated augmentation strategies through controlled ablations, examining classwise errors and prediction confidence to distinguish corruption sensitivity from baseline classification difficulty.

work.title: Image Preprocessing and Validation Utilities
bullets: Implemented assigned image validation routines that checked file readability, channel consistency, and dimensions before passing inputs to an existing processing pipeline.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and updated error handling to provide actionable diagnostics during routine image ingestion.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Semantic Segmentation Architectures
bullets: Implemented a U-Net and a convolutional encoder-decoder baseline for foreground segmentation, using shared preprocessing and matched training settings.
Compared overlap metrics and inspected boundary errors across object sizes, examining how skip connections affected segmentation of thin structures.

projects.title: Visual Similarity Retrieval with Color and Learned Features
bullets: Implemented image retrieval pipelines using color histograms and pretrained convolutional features, applying consistent feature normalization and nearest-neighbor ranking procedures.
Compared retrieval precision using category labels and inspected mismatched results to assess sensitivity to background clutter and viewpoint changes.
